utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s picking up speed today, so I figured I’d pass that along. If you need details, I can ask around.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around and see what I can find out for you.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep the repair drive moving and let Noah know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, just keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do, I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a look after lunch. Just send me the details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, send me the details and I'll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll send them over once I get them. Keep me posted.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly parts and a bit of labor — I’ve got a list, but I could use another pair of hands to sort what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help sort through the list. Show me what you still need, and I’ll see what I can track down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the drive, but I need to work around pickup and drop-off times with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That works. I can coordinate the drive around the school times and help slot you in where it fits best.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, send me the times you’re filling and I’ll see what fits.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Oren. Let’s keep it simple: tell me what needs fixing on the drive, and I’ll follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Morning, Eli. I think the drive just needs the loose hinge and that rough patch by the gate fixed up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that’s clear. Point me to the hinge and the rough patch, and I’ll keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Pia — I’m spreading the word about the repair drive, and I can swing by to help too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll keep spreading the word, and I’m happy to help with the repair drive this week too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I only got that second-hand. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the latest: sign-ups are open, and the repair drive is focused on small home fixes and tool checks this Saturday afternoon at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’s helpful. I’ll tell the neighbors it’s this Saturday afternoon at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I head over, what exactly does the repair drive need?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It needs small appliance repairs, loose hinges, and any hand tools people can spare. I’m keeping a list so we can match donations to the fixes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I can bring the tools I have and help match them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep things quiet on my end.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help out after sunset if that works. Just point me at the part that needs the least noise.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That works. Meet me by the side gate after sunset, and I’ll show you the quietest piece first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to lend a hand, Mina. Tell me what needs fixing for the drive and I’ll see what tools I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need the saw, drill, and a few screws. Can you bring what you’ve got?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got the saw and drill, and I can bring a handful of screws too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think the repair drive is over by the east lot. I can point you there if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll head that way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Right, it should be easy to spot from the east lot. Let me know if you still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can bring my toolbox by and help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Rey. I’ll bring the toolbox by and we’ll get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know whether the parts and tools are actually lined up before I commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Can you confirm the parts and tools are already on hand, and who’s handling the pickup if they’re not?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help connect folks if you want — what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We still need hands for sorting donated supplies and doing the small fixes, especially tools and a few people who can carry things.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can round up a few people for sorting and carrying, and I’ll ask around for the tools and small-fix help too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got some spare tape and a box of screws if we need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That helps a lot, thanks. I can grab the screws and help with whatever still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, then I’ll set out the tape and we can knock out the rest together.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up today. If you need a hand, I can pass the word around.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can do that. I’ll ask around and see who still needs a fix.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks, Bo. I’ll put you down for the repair drive and send over the details shortly.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I just need you to pick up the parts and bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, I’ll pick them up and bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting the word out about the repair drive now, Nell. I’ll ask around and see who can help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn. Let me know what you hear.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m on it, Nell. I’ll keep asking around and bring you anything useful I hear.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive on my list. Where should I meet you for it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s do the front steps at ten sharp. I’ll be there with the drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ll meet you on the front steps at ten sharp.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going? Do you need anything from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina. I’m checking the last few details now, so if you have any spare tape, screws, or a ladder, that would help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ve got some tape and screws, and I can bring the ladder over too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is moving along. I can ask around and see who still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s good to hear. I might need a reminder or two, but I can still ask around on my end.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good, then I’ll keep checking in while you keep asking around. We can cover more ground that way.
